summary.intent: Fix a failing cross-platform E2E CI test (`test-cross-client-sync`) that broke after merging the phase 46 PR, then resolve PR review comments and audit mutative web paths on the phase 47 branch.
summary.outcome: Traced the E2E failure to a stale contract in `edit-filepointer.mjs` (from PR #488, not the phase-46 merge), fixed it in PR #495 (validated green on all 3 platforms). On PR #494, resolved two CodeRabbit findings, fixed a `deleteFileVersion`/`restoreFileVersion` pin-leak pattern, removed dead upload handlers, and captured a follow-up todo for shared-folder write routing.

repo: `ci-e2e.yml` has no `pull_request` trigger — it only runs on push to `main` or manual dispatch, so SDK contract changes are never E2E-tested before merge.
The `desktop` path filter in `ci-e2e.yml` only includes `packages/crypto/src/**`, not `packages/sdk-core/**` or `tests/desktop-e2e/**`, which is how PR #488's contract drift reached main undetected.
`.mjs` E2E helper scripts under `packages/sdk-core/scripts/` are not typechecked or linted and can silently diverge from the SDK contract they exercise.

PR #488 changed `updateFileMetadata` to publish the file IPNS record internally and return `{ ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids }` — the old `{ ipnsRecord, prunedCids }` shape was dropped, but the E2E script wasn't updated.
`apps/api/src/main.ts` runs NestJS `ValidationPipe` with `forbidNonWhitelisted: true`, so any unknown DTO property causes an immediate deterministic 400 with no server-side error log.

`handleAddFile` and `handleAddFiles` in `useFileOperations.ts` were dead code — the active upload path is `getSdkClient().uploadFiles()` via `useDropUpload.ts:147`. These handlers used the old direct `sdk-core` call pattern and would have desynchronised `folderTree` if ever invoked.
`useSharedWriteOps` uses `SharedWriteContext`/refs directly (not the owner's SDK client `folderTree`) — currently by design because shared-with-me folders aren't tracked in the owner's `folderTree`.

`deleteFileVersion` and `restoreFileVersion` web hooks discarded the SDK-returned `prunedCids` from conflict-merge rounds (409 retry path), leaking orphaned pins. Sibling methods `replaceFile` and `restoreFileVersion` on the SDK already returned them correctly.
Phase 46 and 47 todos were not moved to `completed/` after their PRs merged — this was an open cleanup task at session end.

code.finding: Script destructured `{ ipnsRecord }` from `updateFileMetadata` (old contract) and passed it to `replaceFileInFolder`. After PR #488, `updateFileMetadata` no longer returns `ipnsRecord`; the file record is published internally. The fix removes the `replaceFileInFolder` call and adds `baseChildren` to the folder republish, mirroring `useFileOperations.ts`.
`base * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5)` yields `[0.5x, 1.0x)` — one-sided bias toward early retries. The comment documents ±50% jitter (`[0.5x, 1.5x)`). Fixed to `base * (0.5 + Math.random())`.

`resolveIpnsRecord` and the not-found throw were placed before the `try` block, so `fileIpnsPrivateKey.fill(0)` in the `finally` was skipped if either failed. Moved both inside the `try` to guarantee key zeroing on all exit paths (T-47-01 requirement).

`deleteFileVersion` did a bare `await updateFileMetadata(...)` and discarded the return, dropping `prunedCids`. On a 409-conflict merge round, those CIDs leak as orphaned pins. Fixed to return `{ deletedCid, prunedCids }` matching the `replaceFile`/`restoreFileVersion` pattern.

The `restoreFileVersion` hook unpinned only web-computed cap-prune CIDs from `computeRestoreVersionUpdate`, discarding the SDK-returned conflict-merge `prunedCids`. Fixed to unpin the deduped union of both sets.

`handleAddFile` (lines 44–175) and `handleAddFiles` (lines 187–334) called `addFileToFolder`/`addFilesToFolder` directly from `sdk-core`, bypassing `client.folderTree`. Both were dead code — verified no component consumed them through `useFolder()`. Removed entirely (−310 lines).

workflow: 1Password SSH signing agent gets permanently wedged after a timed-out `git commit` attempt; subsequent attempts fail with `failed to fill whole buffer`. Recovery requires quitting and restarting 1Password. The reliable pattern is background + unsandboxed `git commit` with no timeout so the Touch ID prompt can surface.
`gh run view --log` is unreliable for large/expired CI logs; fetching raw job logs via the GitHub REST API (`/repos/.../actions/jobs/{id}/logs`) is more reliable.
For CodeRabbit CLI reviews use `coderabbit review --agent --base-commit <merge-base-sha>` to scope findings to the branch diff.
When an adversarial workflow returns 'ship' on all lenses but flags a latent out-of-scope issue, capture it as a GSD todo immediately rather than holding it in memory.
After merging origin/main into a feature branch, verify STATE.md's conflict-free merge before committing — the pending-todos count and headers can conflict.

friction: 1Password SSH signing agent wedged after the first timed-out commit attempt, requiring a full app restart and multiple retry cycles before commits could land.
`gh run view --log` returned no output for the failing CI run (likely artifact expiry or size limit); had to fall back to the GitHub REST API for raw job logs.
E2E CI has no `pull_request` trigger and the `desktop` path filter excludes `packages/sdk-core/**`, so SDK contract drift (PR #488) reached main without any E2E gate.
CodeRabbit web review rate-limited; had to fall back to the CLI (`coderabbit review --agent`) to get automated review coverage on PR #494.

Test 4c in `cas.test.ts` initially had a redundant second `publishWithCas` invocation (copied from the existing Test 3 pattern) — flagged by the adversarial review workflow and cleaned up before commit.
open_items: Add `packages/sdk-core/src/**`, `packages/sdk/src/**`, and `tests/desktop-e2e/**` to the `desktop` path filter in `ci-e2e.yml`, and add a `pull_request` trigger, so SDK contract changes trigger E2E before merging to main (PR #495 comment flagged this; not yet implemented).

Route `useSharedWriteOps` mutations through the SDK client instead of `SharedWriteContext`/refs directly (todo captured: `.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-15-route-shared-folder-writes-through-the-sdk-client.md`).
Move phase 46 and phase 47 todos from `pending/` to `completed/` — the session ended with the merge commit in-flight and this step not yet completed.

The `restoreFileVersion` web hook's parallel pin-leak (web-computed vs SDK-returned prunedCids) was fixed in this session, but the adversarial review noted the pattern could recur wherever web hooks compute prunedCids independently of SDK conflict-merge returns.
